description.zh: 按住右键、中键或侧键画一下，或配合另一个鼠标键做组合手势：后退、关窗口、切标签页；选中文字后画一下或按快捷键：复制、搜索、翻译；画个圈、推到屏幕角落、在屏幕边上来回蹭、按住手势键滚滚轮，都能设成按键、打开程序、输入文字或关机重启。可以只在某个程序里、某个角落里生效。管理员身份运行的窗口里用不了
description.en: Hold the right, middle or side button and draw, or combine with a second mouse button: back, close the window, switch tabs. Select words, then draw or press a shortcut: copy, search, translate. Circles, the screen's corners and edges, and the wheel with a trigger button held can press keys, open programs, type text, shut down or restart. A rule can hold in one program or one corner only. Not in windows run as administrator

notes.zh:
手势设成 `Ctrl+↑`、`Shift+↑` 这类组合键时，WPS 里只当成按了方向键：Ctrl、Shift 按下和松开几乎在同一瞬间，WPS 检查时它们已经松开了。现在组合键先全部按下，停 40 毫秒再松开，WPS 和别的程序里都正常（#472）。

每个手势可以写自己的提示文字（#472）：在设置窗口里点动作，弹出面板最下面的“提示文字”里写上“上移段落”这样的话，画手势时轨迹旁就显示它，列表里这一行也用它当标题；不填还是显示动作本身。触发角、摩擦边、快捷键的提示也一样；关机这类先倒数的动作，倒数卡片上照旧写实际要做的事。设快捷键时不再收小键盘的键。权限不变。
notes.en:
A gesture set to `Ctrl+Up` or `Shift+Up` only moved the caret in WPS: Ctrl or Shift went down and up at once, and WPS looked after they were up. Every key of a combination now goes down first and up 40 ms later, in WPS and everywhere else (#472).

A gesture can have hint text of its own (#472): click its action in the settings window and write, say, "Move paragraph up" in 提示文字 at the bottom of the panel; the hint by the trail shows it and the gesture's row takes it as its title, or the action's name when left empty. Hot corners, rubbed edges and shortcuts too; the countdown card of shut down and the like still says what it will do. Hotkeys no longer take a number-pad key. Permissions unchanged.
